headline: Flock cameras remain in Monterey County, despite supervisors’ vote to end contract
summary: Flock Safety has roughly two months to remove more than 60 cameras across unincorporated Monterey County. But automated license plate readers still remain in local cities where police have contracts with Flock — Carmel, Salinas, Seaside, Marina, Monterey and Pacific Grove.
